title: gymnadenia conopsea subsp. borealis
intro: Gymnadenia conopsea subsp. borealis, commonly known as the alpine gymnadenia, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the orchid family (Orchidaceae). This plant is native to the mountainous regions of Northern Europe and is known for its unique, white, and fragrant flowers. The alpine gymnadenia has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems and inflammation, due to its therapeutic actions such as expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its potential health benefits and therapeutic actions.
